out.title: Sun Pharma to present long-term UNLOXCYT aCSCC data at ESMO 2026
out.summary: Sun Pharma will present long-term follow-up data from the CK-301-101 trial of UNLOXCYT (cosibelimab-ipdl) in advanced CSCC at ESMO on October 24, 2026, showing durable responses and low-grade irAEs across 205 patients.
